description: This Java class defines a Serializable entity named ShoppingCartData, which models the data structure of a shopping cart in an e-commerce application. It contains fields such as message, code, quantity, total, subtotal, and lists of OrderTotal and ShoppingCartItem objects, along with their respective getters and setters. The class is annotated with Spring annotations indicating its scope and component status.

classes.name: ShoppingCartData
classes.description: A Java class representing shopping cart data with properties for message, code, quantity, totals, subtotal, total, and shopping cart items. It extends ShopEntity and implements Serializable, with Spring annotations for component and scope.
